title: Business Development Associate (Fresher & Experienced) - Bengaluru
description:
**Business Development Associate - Fresher**

**Location:** Gurgaon & Bengaluru

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Connect with prospective students through calls, video calls, and emails.
* Understand learners' career goals, requirements, and learning needs.
* Counsel prospective students and recommend suitable Scaler programs.
* Manage the end-to-end sales cycle, including lead qualification, counselling, follow-ups, and conversion.
* Follow up with leads generated through marketing campaigns.
* Maintain accurate records of customer interactions in CRM systems.
* Achieve weekly and monthly sales targets.
* Build strong relationships with prospective learners and ensure a positive customer experience.
* Work effectively in a fast-paced and target-driven environment.

**Eligibility:**

* Graduate in any discipline
* Fresher with relevant internship preferred
* Good English communication skills

*CTC 08 LPA fixed + Incentive | Urgent Requirement | Work form Office*

**Business Development Associate - Experienced**

**Location:** Gurgaon & Bengaluru

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Handle high-intent and premium leads for Scaler's EdTech programs.
* Conduct detailed counselling sessions with students and parents.
* Own the complete sales cycle from lead engagement to closure.
* Consistently achieve and exceed monthly revenue targets.
* Handle customer objections and drive successful conversions.
* Guide and support junior BDAs on calls, objection handling, and closures.
* Maintain accurate customer data and follow-ups using CRM tools.
* Share market insights and customer feedback with product and marketing teams.

**Eligibility:**

* Graduate in any discipline.
* PGDM / MBA is preferred.
* 2+ year of relevant experience
* Good English communication skills

title: Business Development Associate
description:
**Business Development Associate (BDA) | Senior Business Development Associate**

**Company:** Scaler Academy  
**Hiring Partner:** OmniJobs  
**Location:** Gurugram / Bangalore  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**CTC:** ₹7 LPA – ₹11.4 LPA

**About the Role**

We are looking for enthusiastic and target-oriented **Business Development Associates (BDA) and Senior Business Development Associate** to join the sales team at The Omnijobs The role involves engaging with prospective learners, understanding their career goals, explaining relevant Scaler programs, and converting qualified leads into enrollments.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Connect with prospective students/leads through calls and other communication channels.
* Follow up with prospective learners and maintain regular communication.
* Handle candidate queries and address concerns effectively.
* Achieve individual and team sales targets.
* Maintain accurate records of leads, follow-ups, and conversions.

**Eligibility Criteria**

* **Qualification:** Graduation in any discipline.
* **Experience:** 0–6 years of experience in sales or related customer -facing roles. (1+ year of EdTech experience is preferred)
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Comfortable working in a target-driven environment.
* Candidates with a strong interest in sales and business development are encouraged to apply.

**Why Join?**

* Opportunity to work with a leading EdTech organization.
* Strong career growth opportunities in sales and business development.
* Exposure to consultative selling and the education technology sector.
* Performance-driven learning and development environment.
